title: Updating to master wipes out settings
body:
Reporting bugs
--------------
- Updating from 3.3.3.0-dev to master results in missing settings and profile information
- Repro steps:
- 0: Export settings
- 1: Build and Install latest Master
- 2: Open AAPS and see all settings set to default. Profiles are missing, although dropdown has 4 "Local Profile 1" selection (corresponding to previous profiles)
- 3: Observe Omnipod Dash and BYODA missing, but is able to be reselected
- 4: Observe Objectives is reset to 0
- 5: Import Settings
- 6: Observe steps 2-4 remain the same.
- 7: Reinstall 3.3.3.0-dev and Import Settings
- 8: Profile, Settings, and Objectives are properly restored.
- Current: 3.3.3.0-dev-a (a667)

See log (Not sure if log captured actions in master, if not I can repro and reattach)
[AndroidAPS._2025-10-13_16-10-19_.md](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/22896134/AndroidAPS._2025-10-13_16-10-19_.md)

comments.body: Apparently going from later version (dev) to earlier version (master) will wipe your db
